scope: Static and synthetic evaluation pre-execution review only; no actual labels, predictions or model arrays read; no fitting.
digest_encoding: SHA256 of UTF-8 compact sorted-key fingerprint JSON
checks: Frozen previously used development labels and exact90calibration/180comparison roles; current train separation inherited through actual reviewed input lock.
Every cap/user keeps observed J, strict-past O, target window and viewed exclusions. Half-star domain, no model-dependent candidate removal.
Equal-user affine calibration: nonnegative slope,20users/40rows,constant and insufficient branches; comparison labels not used for fitting.
Fixed ALL calibrated-MSE/NDCG2 Pareto budget selection; unavailable smaller stops family selection and unavailable larger retains valid smaller.
Raw score ranks, movie-ID ascending ties; errors distinguish raw/clipped/calibrated. J<end and IDCG0 keep separate quality denominators.

Formal comparison requires all three paired seeds339/344/345 and valid primary-cap calibration. Average user-level metrics, not predictions; UID-sorted20k bootstrap seed344, four98.75% intervals, minimum30users.
Descriptive actual ALS is restricted to W_DIRECT; unsupported NaNs are not filled. Older FM_RH/GBT_B use original reference calibration.
Natural/J>=6 cohorts, caps, h, activity, support, metadata, next-two pages and fixed-target O-vs-empty diagnostics remain separate.
Exact selection/calibration parent bytes are captured before use, revalidated with sealed child artifacts and stored unchanged in resulting seals.
Failed fits and insufficient calibrators cannot silently produce full-seed primary results. Resource outcome remains separate from numerical quality.

resolved_findings.issue: Synthetic ev.select reproduced replacement of calibration JSON+seal during execution: old coefficients could receive a new parent pin.
resolved_findings.resolution: Start parent snapshot, end exact seal/child validation, original snapshot recorded in seal. Applied to select, final calibration and final evaluation; new25-test suite passes.

notes: Mean of per-user RMSE differs from sqrt(mean user MSE); report as mean user RMSE.
Review establishes implementation consistency, not service adoption or unseen-user generalization.
Bootstrap uncertainty is conditional on fixed fits/calibrators and reused development users.
Actual runtime/model/result audits remain separate later gates.
